content_of_post_to_answer: Can you suggest ways to roleplay a character who, despite low charisma, is a bleeding heart and always eager to help others?
answer: Low charisma doesn't mean a character lacks influence; it may mean their kindness works through persistence rather than charm. A bleeding heart can be awkward, overlooked, or even annoying, yet still become the person others trust because they show up when it matters. I've explored this kind of character dynamic in more detail on my profile for anyone curious. The interesting contrast is that some of the most compelling helpers aren't loved because they persuade people, but because they refuse to stop caring.
